Test_Case.Test_Purpose: Verify V2GTP header structure construction and validation

Sequence.description: Tester sends a V2GTP message with correct header (ProtocolVersion=0x01, InverseProtocolVersion=0xFE, valid PayloadType=0x8001, accurate PayloadLength); SECC accepts and processes the message normally
Tester sends a V2GTP message with incorrect ProtocolVersion (e.g. 0x02) and correspondingly wrong InverseProtocolVersion; SECC shall reject or close the connection
Tester sends a V2GTP message with correct ProtocolVersion=0x01 but InverseProtocolVersion not equal to 0xFE (XOR pattern violated); SECC shall reject or close the connection
Tester sends a V2GTP message with a reserved PayloadType value (e.g. 0x0001); SECC shall reject or close the connection
